title.description: Readable text in the main book title, excluding the subtitle. Preserve readable partial words; separate portions divided by missing text with an ellipsis. Do not reconstruct missing letters or words. Return null only if no title text is readable.

author.description: Author name as printed on the main book. Do not expand the name using outside knowledge.

publisher_imprint.description: Publisher imprint of the main book.

advertised_books.description: Books advertised in the document for which both the complete main title and the complete author credit are readable. Exclude the main book being photographed. Omit subtitles and skip entries with an incomplete main title or author credit. Return each distinct record once, in any order. Use [] when no complete records are readable; do not reconstruct missing text.

title.description: Complete advertised main book title, without its subtitle.

author.description: Complete author name as printed in the advertised entry.
